design.strategy: Same prepared parent profile at12months,20 frozen bottles, normal3 introductions, same-month20 town versus5town+5station+10super. All legal; age12 differs from natural flavor presets.
design.origins: Same24-month aroma profile and20bottles at one of town/station/specialist/super, exactly one initial introduction. Bar max10 and department max5 excluded, never relaxed.
design.naturalFlavors: Use each recipe natural6/24/30/24month age; all20to town only, flavor and age are confounded. No illegal supermarket route for6month product.
design.timing: Same frozen20bottles: all20at0,4x5same-month0,5at0+5at2+10at4,all20at4; same12month endpoint. Temporal exposure differs, so compare repeats with both early and late bulk controls.
design.portions: One real parent,10bottles each at12/24/36,24elapsed months; offers accepted only when generated. Fixed destination preference is a mechanical probe, not human next-choice evidence.
design.logicalTasks: Count delivery, explicit offer acceptance, one-month advances; shared setup bottling omitted. API action count is not observed UI click burden.
design.native: Default retail sold0; established reference constructs40retail sales across2releases, not full native offers/contracts/replay. Six-store network remains fictional.

portions.selection: Prefer an actually accepted specialist, then bar, then town, then supermarket, otherwise first legal destination; never fabricate introductions.

limits: No native six-store offer parity. Native delivery is not retail evidence; zero baseline can legitimately create no offers.
Main20strategy uses common12month age; all prices may be at the16floor and some future shops cannot handle that frozen product.
Natural recipe comparisons change age and profile together; they do not isolate a flavor-axis coefficient.
All20 initial bottles are consumed. New offers do not create stock: existing legal next targets can be zero until another actual parent portion is bottled.
A seeded route is not a guarantee of a new offer; price, age, taste, stock preview and eligibility can prevent it.
Familiarity is conditional and recent; past repeat invitation/fulfillment and current continuing flags are different metrics.
Accept all genuine offers is an analysis policy; the user may decline. No automatic follow-up deliveries are made by the model.
Potential next targets from a new10-bottle portion are a counterfactual inspection, not extra deliveries in the strategy comparison.
No scalar optimum, human enjoyment, real word-of-mouth behavior or spontaneous next-bottling motivation is established.
